Sasha R: Vendor just updated ETA — partial H100 shipment could arrive Thu morning. Can we confirm a staging slice for nightly canary? /cc @Marta L @Leo P
Marta L: 👍 what's the expected count?
Sasha R: Vendor said 4 nodes (16 GPUs). We only need 2 nodes for the canary. Prefer us-west2.
Leo P: I can carve 2 nodes if billing ok. Nina, any objections to short-lived demo allocation?
Nina (Finance): short-lived is fine, just tag with project=canary and cost-center=prod-eval
Viktor (vendor-liaison): Confirmed — partial shipment scheduled for 2026-06-03 08:00 UTC, customs still pending but likely. We'll provide serials 48h before.
ops-bot: Reminder: Please open an allocation ticket and include `region=us-west2`, `count=2`, `ttl=48h` to auto-provision.
Sasha R: Opening ticket now. Terraform snippet below for the claim (copy/paste):
```
resource "gpu_slice_claim" "canary" {
  region = "us-west2"
  node_count = 2
  ttl = "48h"
  tags = { project = "canary", owner = "sasha" }
}
```
Marta L: I'll review the TF and lgtm once PR shows up. Expecting to run smoke at 10:30 UTC.
Leo P: I'll queue the canary images. If vendor delays, fall back to preemptible a100 pool — ping me.
Sasha R: Thanks — tagging this with @oncall in case of customs delay. Will update when ticket done. :eyes:
Nina (Finance): Also add label `charge=demo` so billing can reconcile quickly.
Sasha R: Ticket #12456 opened: https://tickets.internal/12456 — added tags and ETA. Will post serials when Viktor shares.
Viktor (vendor-liaison): Will send serials by Tue 06:00 UTC. Good luck with canary!
Marta L: :party-parrot: Nice. I'll schedule the smoke window and add runbook steps.
Sasha R: Closing loop — will post a short status in #eng-infra when smoke passes.
